name: generateAdminReports
shortDescription: Aggregates and processes data from various entities to generate configurable administrative reports with export capabilities.
description:
Overview

Aggregates and processes data related to appointments, user engagement, and communication metrics to generate configurable reports for administrators. The function supports various report types and can prepare data for export (e.g., CSV/PDF).

Intended use

Called by the admin dashboard UI when an administrator requests to generate a report.

Logic

  1. Receive parameters specifying the report type (e.g., 'appointment_summary', 'patient_demographics'), date range, and filters.
  2. Query Appointment, PatientProfile, DoctorProfile, and Message entities using ctx.data.query or ctx.data.list based on the report type and filters.
  3. Aggregate and process the retrieved data (e.g., count appointments by status, summarize patient demographics, calculate message volume).
  4. Format the aggregated data into a structured output suitable for display or export.
  5. Audit-log the report generation using ctx.audit.log.
  6. Return the generated report data.

Entities

  • Appointment
  • PatientProfile
  • DoctorProfile
  • Message
